title: Kähler differentials as the conormal module of the diagonal
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $I=\ker(\mu:A\otimes_R A\to A)$ be the kernel of the multiplication map $\mu(a\otimes b)=ab$. Regard $I/I^2$ as an $A$-module through $(A\otimes_R A)/I\cong A$. Then there is a canonical isomorphism of $A$-modules $\Omega_{A/R}\cong I/I^2$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] sending $\mathrm da$ to the class of $1\otimes a-a\otimes 1$ for every $a\in A$.
